name: Analyze literary texts for themes and techniques
description: Users provided texts of short stories, novels, or narrative passages and requested detailed literary analysis focusing on characters, themes, plot structures, and stylistic devices. They also asked for interpretations of specific literary techniques, such as irony, symbolism, and rhetorical devices, often requiring comparisons between different works or narrative elements.
